These are explicitly synthetic scalar artifacts, not downloaded production budget values.
The history spike found zero usable scalar archive bytes. Its sanitized observations guide
these cases: absent artifacts, cancelled/incomplete measurements, retries, and completed
usable results despite workflow failure. No host job timestamp becomes a measurement.

`budget-run.json` supplies one ordinary result. The comparison and installed-consumer
journeys expand it to 100 catalog budgets across 20 unique base commits. Run ids, URLs,
scalar values, CPU counts and timestamps in these fixtures are synthetic. Repository/ref
mismatches, missing rows and attempts are changed explicitly by each journey.
